title: Pepperoni Pizza Cheese Drip Chips
description: These pizza chips from Chef John are the most delightful crispy, caramelized, and cheesy treats that everyone will love! Add whatever pizza toppings you're into!

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Line a 13x18-inch, half-sheet pan with parchment paper.
Grate provolone and mozzarella cheeses with the larger side of a box grater into a large bowl. Use the smaller side and grate in Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese. Toss with your hands to combine.

Scoop tablespoonfuls of the cheese mixture into 12 circular piles on the prepared baking sheet, making sure you're getting all three cheeses in each scoop. Top each circle with about ¾ teaspoon pizza sauce, then place a slice of pepperoni on top.
Bake in the center of the preheated oven until melted and sizzling, 12 to 15 minutes.
Remove parchment paper and chips to a wire rack to cool. Line the baking sheet with a fresh sheet of parchment paper.
Repeat Steps 3 to 5 to bake remaining 18 chips.
Let chips cool to room temperature, 15 to 20 minutes. Remove from the parchment paper and serve.

video.description: In this video, Chef John shares his recipe for Pepperoni Pizza Cheese Drip Chips. He grates provolone, mozzarella, and Parmesan cheese and mixes them together to create a three-cheese blend. He places spoonfuls of the cheese blend on a lined baking tray, tops them with a little pizza sauce and a slice of pepperoni. He then bakes them for 12 to 15 minutes until they are crispy and crunchy. Not only do they taste like the cheesy bits that drip off of a pizza, they also have a crusty, chewy center and crispy edges. The recipe is no-carb and gluten-free, and other pizza toppings can be used instead of pepperoni.
